spans.s:
लुठ् 1. लुठ्, cl. 1. P. लोठति, लुलोठ,
अलुठत्, लोठितुम्, to strike, knock down;
cl. 1. A. लोठते, लुलुठे, अलोठिष्ट, to resist,
oppose, repel; to suffer pain; to go (according to
Naigh.

); cl. 10. P. लोठयति [cf. rt. लुण्ठ्],
to rob, plunder, steal, pillage, sack.

लुठ् 2. लुठ्, cl. 6. P. लुठति, लुलोठ,
अलुठत्, &c., लुठितुम्, to roll, roll
about, move about, move to and fro, roll on the
ground, wallow, welter; to roll down; to agitate,
move, stir, (in this sense = rt. लुड्): Caus. लोठ-
यति, -यितुम्, Aor. अलूलुठत् or अलुलोठत्, to cause
to roll, make to move to and fro: Desid. लुलुठि-
षते, to wish to roll, intend to roll, to be on the
point of rolling; [cf. Hib. liuth, ‘I move, hasten.’]

लुठत्, अन्, अती or अन्ती, अत्, rolling, rolling on the
ground, falling down; flowing, trickling (?).

लुठन, अम्, n. the act of rolling, rolling or
wallowing on the earth, rolling on the ground with
sorrow.
—लुठनेश्वर-तीर्थ (˚न-ईश्˚), अम्, n.,
N. of a Tīrtha.

लुठमान, अस्, आ, अम्, rolling, moving to and
fro.

लुठित, अस्, आ, अम्, rolled, rolled down, rolling
on the ground (as a horse &c.); fallen; (अम्), n.
the rolling on the ground (of a horse).
लुठेश्वर (˚ठ-ईश्˚), अम्, n., N. of a Tīrtha.
